note: Sound for milestone M5: every Mod, Riff, Boost and Fusion the first slice did not have, and the one-shot recipes the bosses, mini-bosses, structures, events and elite traits ask for on their pages. Same schema as conductor.json's 'mods', 'riffs' and 'boosts' blocks: when the audio engineer builds this, those three blocks move into conductor.json and this file keeps only 'recipes', 'fusions' and 'where'. It is a separate file until then so that a build in progress does not meet names it does not know. Steps are sixteenths (16 per bar). Levels are linear, relative to the voice's own mix level. Scale degrees are steps of the Track's scale above the arpeggio note. Everything a kill, a hit or a bounce triggers is aggregated like kills are: at most one sound of a kind on a 1/32 step, its gain 1 - e^(-count / 2.5). Starting values: the user tunes by ear at the M5 play test.

riffs.note: Each Riff is one instrument on one pattern, heard only while a player owns it. 'pattern' is 16 steps, digits are velocity ninths. Riffs 1 to 3 are in conductor.json.

lancer.charge: a reverse swell at 0.3 over the three beats before
lancer.says: a full chord on beat 4, the beam; from level 3 on beats 2 and 4 ('....9.......9...')

minelayer.drop: a closed hat on step 8 as each mine is laid
minelayer.says: the mines of the last bar go off together on the One

storm_coil.notes: the chord's stab triad and its root an octave up, in turn, one octave above the stab
storm_coil.says: a zap on each triplet eighth on which something was struck

swarm.notes: the chord's arp from step 0, one note a missile
swarm.says: the volley is a rising run on the One

singularity.says: a reverse swell while it pulls, the boom on the next One

mirror.says: the wingman is the player's own lead an octave up

comet.says: out on the One, back on three

sweeper.says: a drone that opens as the arm comes round to twelve o'clock and closes behind it

flak.says: a snare with each burst, on two and four; from level 4 a clap a 1/32 after it as the pellets go off

mods.note: What each Mod does to the lead or adds to the mix, per stack. Mods 1 to 4, 11, 17, 18, 25 and 31 are in conductor.json.

fork.perStack: on a first hit the note is answered a 1/32 later by the fifth above at 0.4

seeker.perStack: each lead note glides in from the note before it over 12 ms

heavy_step.perStack: every fourth lead step (3, 7, 11, 15) is doubled an octave down on the bass patch at 0.8; its explosion is the small kill's thud at 0.5

accent.perStack: the accented note (beat 1; then 1 and 3; then every beat) plays at 1.4 with the chord's stab under it at 0.3

echo.perStack: the lead's delay is one beat long and its mix rises by 0.15

wave.perStack: vibrato on the lead: 5.5 Hz, 18 cents

rear_guard.perStack: a counter-melody two scale degrees below the arpeggio on the off-beat eighths (steps 2, 6, 10, 14) at 0.5; the second stack adds the note five degrees below on steps 1 and 9

arc.perStack: each chain is a zap one chord tone above the last, up to three

burn.perStack: a crackle whose density follows the number of burning enemies (none to thirty), at 0.08

shatter.perStack: a glass burst on each kill that throws shrapnel, at 0.25

gravity_rounds.perStack: a soft low thup on each hit (sine 180 to 120 Hz, 40 ms) at 0.15

afterimage.perStack: the Dash's sweep is heard again a beat later at half level, from where the decoy stands

shockstep.perStack: the Dash adds a tom on the chord's root; a Perfect Dash a second tom a fifth above

aegis.perStack: a high tick for each bullet the arc stops, 6 dB under the Shard chirp (the first number, 0.15 of the tick, came out at -63 dBFS: nobody would have heard it)

last_light.perStack: the free mini-Nova is the Nova's blast at 0.6, without the inhale

collector.perStack: the Boost it spawns arrives with the Boost bells

syncopation.perStack: off-beat notes are 0.3 louder and carry a short square blip an octave up

bar_line.perStack: the cross is the chord's stab at 0.5 with a zap, on the One

crescendo.perStack: the lead rises 0.2 dB for each bar without a hit, to +2 dB, and the pad opens with it; a hit drops both at once

kick_pulse.perStack: a tom an octave above the kick's pitch doubles each kick at 0.2: on Tracks whose kick is not on every beat the ring follows the kick, not the beat

afterparty.perStack: the Surge's lead gear holds for the two extra bars

boosts.note: For the Boost's duration. Prism, Hyper, Halo and Magnet Storm are in conductor.json. Every Boost is picked up with the Boost bells.
boosts.supernova_rounds: each impact is the small kill's thud at 0.3
boosts.colossus: the bass gains its octave below at 0.5; each enemy rammed is a tom on the chord's root
boosts.time_stretch: the drums play at half rate (every pattern stretched to two bars) while the lead and the Riffs keep their grid: the room slows, the player does not
boosts.freeze_frame: a glass chord as it starts; the music bus is high-passed at 800 Hz for its two bars; each shattered enemy is a glass burst
boosts.black_hole: the Nova's inhale lasts the singularity's three beats, rising; then the blast with the sub drop
boosts.chain_storm: on every beat a zap on each of the chord's three stab notes at 0.35
boosts.chorus: the lead is doubled a fifth above and an octave below at 0.4 each
boosts.beam: the lead holds: each step retriggers softly with four times the decay, over the Sweeper's drone on the arpeggio's first note
boosts.ricochet_fever: the bounce blips climb two scale steps a bounce
boosts.confetti: each kill adds a run of six Shard chirps up the scale
boosts.fractal: each lead note is followed a 1/32 apart by its octave at 0.3 and its double octave at 0.15
boosts.carousel: each launch is a tom: root, third, fifth and octave of the chord on beats 1 to 4

fusions.note: A Fusion replaces the sounds of its two ingredients.
fusions.helix_array: Split's harmony notes take Wave's vibrato in opposite phase to the lead: a slow chorus
fusions.standing_wave: each accented note is held for a bar as a pad voice on the same pitch
fusions.tesla_bloom: each ring's tom carries a zap on all three stab notes
fusions.shard_halo: the Orbitals' shaker is doubled by glass ticks an octave apart
fusions.downbeat_cannon: on every One the full chord stab at 1.2 with the impact at 0.5
fusions.collapse_field: a reverse swell over the last beat of each bar runs into the mines' detonation
fusions.murmuration: the run does not stop: a 1/32 trill between the chord's third and fifth at 0.25 while the flock lives
fusions.quartet: the lead in four parts: the note, the third and fifth above it and the octave, the upper three at 0.4

recipes.note: One-shots and voices the pages name, in the engine's own building blocks (design/music/README.md, 'Recipes for the engine port' and 'Sound effects'). Pitched ones take a note; 'the chord' and 'the scale' are the Track's at that moment.
recipes.tom: the 'pulse' voice at a pitch: a sine sweeping from 4.8 x the note to the note in 45 ms, 130 ms decay, with its noise tick
recipes.sub_drop: the impact's sine alone: 120 to 38 Hz, 700 ms
recipes.gong: the P3 bell two octaves down with ratio 1.4 and index 3, 2.5 s decay
recipes.bell: the P3 bell at a note
recipes.zap: the medium kill without its noise: a sine gliding from twice the pitch to the pitch, 90 ms, ring-modulated at 2.76 x
recipes.glass: three sines at 3, 4.2 and 5.4 x a note in the seventh octave, 60 ms
recipes.saw_glide: a detuned saw pair through the lead's low-pass, gliding by an interval over a time (the Alpha's howl: up a fifth over one beat)
recipes.sweep: the Dash: noise through a low-pass that opens or closes over a given time
recipes.rev_cymbal: the impact's crash reversed, a beat or a bar long, ending on a grid line
recipes.woodblock: a sine falling from 1 kHz to 700 Hz in 8 ms, 35 ms decay, with a 3 kHz click; pitched by scale step when a page says so
recipes.chirp: the Shard's chirp at a note
recipes.drone: a detuned saw pair an octave under the bass through a low-pass whose cutoff is given, held
recipes.pad_voice: one note of the pad patch, held while something lives: one voice for each thing
recipes.crackle: 5 ms bursts of 2 to 6 kHz noise at a given density
recipes.whoosh: noise through a band-pass sweeping 400 Hz to 3 kHz over a beat (and back for a return)
recipes.roll: the Build's snare roll over a given span of beats
recipes.low_pass_bed: the music bus low-passed (SetMuffle) for a time: used for 'stunned', 'dazed' and 'open' moments

effectsInKey.note: The one-shots that were written in A minor (the Boost bells, the upgrade chord and its bell arpeggio, the elite's fifth, the game over) follow the Track: they are part of the music.
effectsInKey.rule: transpose to the Track's root; on the major Tracks (7 Afterglow, 8 Arcadia) and the lydian one (9 Mirage) the minor thirds become major
effectsInKey.outsideTheScale: a transposed note that is not in the Track's scale is not played as written: in a chord it is left out, in an arpeggio it becomes the chord's third in that octave. Today that is one note: the upgrade chord's ninth on Furnace (A over G phrygian), so Furnace's upgrade is G minor seventh with the arpeggio D, F, B flat, D

where.note: The sound of each fight and each thing in the arena is on its own page, in its 'Sound' section or row, written in the words of 'recipes' above.
where.bosses: design/bosses/kaleidos.md, longwave.md, choir.md, horizon.md, polyrhythm.md, feedback.md; the four for Tracks 7 to 10 when their pages are written
where.minibosses: design/bosses/minibosses.md, the 'Sound' row of each of the twelve
